prediction_time: At discharge, after the index encounter's diagnoses, tests, and treatment are recorded
target: Recorded readmission in less than 30 days; >30 and NO are negative
exclusion_reason: Recorded death or hospice discharge; retain all ages and other dispositions
split: Patient SHA-256 of uci296-patient-v1:ID, first 8 bytes modulo 100: 0-69 train, 70-84 validation, 85-99 test
selection: Highest validation average precision; ties follow model order; never refit or select on test
preprocessing: Training-only median numeric imputation and standardization; constant missing categorical imputation and one-hot encoding with unknown categories ignored
diagnosis_groups: ICD-9: diabetes 250; circulatory 390-459; respiratory 460-519; digestive 520-579; genitourinary 580-629; injury 800-999; neoplasm 140-239; V supplemental; E external; other; missing
ranking: Rank within each evaluation split; ceil(n*capacity); ties use SHA-256 of uci296-rank-v1:encounter_id, independent of target
evaluation_role: Retrospective patient-grouped internal benchmark; no calendar dates, chronological validation, independent hospital validation, or clinical deployment claim
compute: Local scikit-learn CPU models only; no paid model APIs or automatic hyperparameter search
